score_path_functionals.label: NFL score-path functionals (largest lead, lead changes, comebacks)
score_path_functionals.target: Whether the path of the score in one game (largest lead, count of lead changes, a comeback of N or more points) reaches a threshold.
score_path_functionals.why_distinct: Settles on a functional of the full score trajectory (running maximum, sign changes of the margin, deficit recovery), which needs a score-path simulation chain, not an additive team stat count.

rare_play_call_events.label: NFL rare play-call events (non-QB pass, goal-line pass)
rare_play_call_events.target: Whether a named rare play call (a pass attempt by a non-quarterback, a pass attempt from on or inside the 1-yard line) occurs at least once in one game.
rare_play_call_events.why_distinct: A coaching-scheme and situation-frequency hazard (trick plays, goal-line pass rate, quarterback availability) rather than a team production count or a score path.

league_tie_and_long_kick_counts.label: NFL league-wide tie and long-field-goal counts
league_tie_and_long_kick_counts.target: Whether a league-wide count of rare outcomes (tied games in a season or week, made field goals from 60+ yards in a season) reaches a threshold.
league_tie_and_long_kick_counts.why_distinct: A league-wide rare-event count aggregated over every game of a window (Poisson-type with schedule exposure, overtime rules, kicker range), not a single-game or single-team count.

team_window_event_hazards.label: NFL team event hazards over a multi-week schedule window
team_window_event_hazards.target: Whether a named team records at least one occurrence of a defensive event (an interception) in any regular-season game inside a stated window of weeks after issuance.
team_window_event_hazards.why_distinct: A survival (at-least-once) probability over a list of future games with opponent quarterbacks, schedule and issuance-timing rules, not an additive count inside one game or a league-wide season count.
